title: 9 Best Herbal Creams For Gum Infection
intro: Herbal creams for gum infection are topical ointments or creams that are used to treat various gum-related ailments, such as gingivitis, periodontitis, and tooth decay, by utilizing the antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties of herbs. The benefits of using herbal creams to treat gum infections include reducing pain and inflammation, preventing further infection, and promoting healing of the affected area. Examples of herbal creams that can be used to treat gum infections include Neem cream, which is known for its antibacterial properties, Aloe Vera cream, which soothes and calms the gums, and Tea Tree oil cream, which has antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. Additionally, other herbal creams like Echinacea cream, Clove oil cream, and Myrrh cream can also be used to treat gum infections due to their antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties that help in reducing inflammation and promoting healing.

preparations.preparation_desc: Eucalyptus globulus creams have been traditionally used to treat gum infections due to their anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to reduce swelling and prevent the spread of infection. The herbal preparation contains bioactive constituents such as eucalyptol, limonene, and alpha-pinene, which exhibit potent antimicrobial activities against a wide range of bacteria and fungi responsible for gum infections. By applying eucalyptus globulus creams topically, patients can experience relief from symptoms such as pain, redness, and swelling associated with gum infections. The benefits of using eucalyptus globulus creams to treat gum infections include rapid healing, reduced risk of complications, and minimal side effects, making it a popular natural remedy among oral health practitioners.

Echinacea purpurea creams have gained popularity for their potential to treat gum infections, a common oral health issue. The anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties of this herbal preparation help to reduce inflammation and prevent the growth of bacteria that cause gum infections. The bioactive constituents of Echinacea purpurea, including alkylamides, glycosides, and phenolic acids, contribute to its therapeutic effects by boosting the immune system and fighting off pathogens. By using Echinacea purpurea creams, individuals can potentially alleviate symptoms of gum infections, such as pain, swelling, and bleeding, and promote overall oral health.

Calendula officinalis creams have been traditionally used to treat gum infections due to their anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which help to reduce swelling and combat the underlying infection. The bioactive constituents, including triterpenoids and flavonoids, in Calendula officinalis creams have been shown to exhibit potent antimicrobial activity, inhibiting the growth of pathogenic bacteria and fungi. These creams help to treat gum infections by reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and preventing further bacterial colonization. The benefits of using Calendula officinalis creams to treat gum infections include reduced pain and discomfort, accelerated healing, and a lower risk of recurrence, making it a popular natural remedy among dental professionals and patients alike.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Supportive care in cancer : official journal of the Multinational Association of Supportive Care in Cancer", Calendula officinalis creams for gum infection have been shown to improve lesions and reduce pain symptomatology in cancer patients undergoing treatment.

preparations.preparation_desc: Melaleuca alternifolia creams, derived from the leaves of the tea tree, have been traditionally used to treat various gum infections, including gingivitis and periodontitis, due to their potent antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents present in these creams, such as terpinen-4-ol and cineole, exhibit strong antiseptic and antibacterial properties, effectively reducing the growth of microorganisms that cause gum infections. By applying Melaleuca alternifolia creams to the affected area, individuals can help to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and promote a healthy oral environment. The benefits of using Melaleuca alternifolia creams to treat gum infections include reduced risk of tooth loss, improved oral hygiene, and a decrease in the need for antibiotics and other medications.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Journal of ethnopharmacology", Melaleuca alternifolia creams for gum infection may be beneficial in reducing gingivitis (GI) scores, although it only demonstrated a low reduction in plaque index (PI).

preparations.preparation_desc: Aloe barbadensis creams, derived from the Aloe vera plant, have been used for centuries to treat gum infections, also known as periodontitis. The bioactive constituents, such as aloin and aloe-emodin, possess potent antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities that help to combat gum infections. By using Aloe barbadensis creams, individuals can benefit from reduced inflammation, improved wound healing, and a lower risk of complications associated with gum infections.
preparations.preparation_study: According to the study published in the Journal of International Society of Preventive & Community Dentistry, Aloe barbadensis creams have excellent applications in treating periodontal diseases.

preparations.preparation_study: According to "Journal of clinical and diagnostic research : JCDR", Zingiber officinale creams, which is commonly known as ginger, showed significant antimicrobial properties against oral microorganisms causing caries, with a zone of inhibition of 25mm.

preparations.preparation_desc: Glycyrrhiza glabra creams, derived from the licorice plant, have been traditionally used to treat gum infections due to their anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. preparations.preparation_study: According to "Indian journal of dental research : official publication of Indian Society for Dental Research", Glycyrrhiza glabra creams for gum infection have been found to have potential antibacterial activity, with a highest mean zone of inhibition (ZOI) of 9.2 ± 1.09 mm and 10.6 ± 0.54 mm at 24 h against primary plaque colonizers and periodontal pathogens respectively.

preparations.preparation_study: According to "Advances in experimental medicine and biology", Curcuma longa creams for gum infection may have beneficial effects against Candida albicans, which is associated with oral candidiasis.

intro_study: According to the "Journal of ethnopharmacology" study, creams for gum infection using medicinal plant extracts such as Camellia sinensis and Azadirachta indica have shown efficacy in reducing periodontal parameters, including plaque index (PI) and gingival index (GI), which could potentially be used as a safer and newer treatment for gum infections.
